name: New user's Contacts and Notifications screens look right
description: A brand-new user opens the Contacts and Notifications screens. Contacts starts with a few suggested contacts built into the app, and Notifications settles into a clear 'No notifications' message instead of a blank list or a stuck spinner.
details: A brand-new user with zero follows and zero DMs opens Contacts and Notifications from the drawer. Contacts is deliberately NOT empty for a fresh user — the default mints' Nostr contacts (Sovran/Minibits/Cuba) seed the list, on every filter (product truth exposed by this scenario's first runs; no reachable empty case exists on this surface) — while Notifications settles from its spinner into 'No notifications' (notifications-empty:none, the viewer-ready branch, never 'No profile') — not a blank list or a stuck spinner; drawer.navigation only ever asserted the nav titles
